mechanism: Walk highs/lows over LookbackBars; mark peak when low falls ThresholdPoints below running high (and trough when high rises ThresholdPoints above running low), alternating isUpTrend. Six-extrema H&S / inverse-H&S sequences then require head extreme vs shoulders, ShoulderTolerancePoints / TroughTolerancePoints symmetry, MinBarRange–MaxBarRange spacing, BarRangeMultiplier uniformity, and ValidationBars post-right-shoulder confirmation before neckline breakout entry.
data_needed: CopyHigh/CopyLow series; ThresholdPoints, ShoulderTolerancePoints, TroughTolerancePoints, Min/MaxBarRange, BarRangeMultiplier, ValidationBars; neckline slope from trough/peak pair.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol/_Period (forex-style points); LookbackBars default 50; any TF with enough bars for 6 extrema.
why_new_for_mis: Point-threshold extrema chain plus geometric uniformity/validation as a portable reversal-structure change sensor—MIS can emit regime-turn candidates without hardcoding named patterns.
quote: when a reversal exceeds ThresholdPoints, we expand extrema… store details like bar, time, price, and isPeak… and switch the trend, enabling precise pattern identification.

mechanism: Over statAnalysisPeriod bars compute RSI mean and population stdev. Optional filter: buy only if RSI just crossed above oversold AND current RSI < mean − statDeviationFactor×stdev; sell only if crossed below overbought AND RSI > mean + factor×stdev. MACD main+signal both <0 (buy) or >0 (sell) as directional zone confirm. Cascading layers are execution, not sensing.
data_needed: iRSI buffer; CalculateRSIAverage / CalculateRSIStandardDeviation over statAnalysisPeriod; rsiOverbought/Oversold; MACD MAIN/SIGNAL; useStatisticalFilter toggle.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol/_Period; RSI lookback 14; statAnalysisPeriod default 20; MACD 12/26/9.
why_new_for_mis: Turns classic RSI cross into a statistically extreme reading vs its own recent distribution—MIS can reuse mean±k·σ as a portable significance gate on any oscillator.

mechanism: Detect swing highs/lows with SwingHighCount/SwingLowCount neighborhood. Last five swings X-A-B-C-D must satisfy AB∈[0.382,0.618]·XA, BC∈[1.272,1.414]·AB, |CD−0.786·XC|≤FibonacciTolerance·XC, and D beyond X (bullish D<X / bearish D>X). Pattern-lock on formation bar + locked X waits one bar so structure does not repaint before trade.
data_needed: SwingPoints array (time, price, isSwingHigh); FibonacciTolerance; five most recent swings; g_patternFormationBar / g_lockedPatternX lock.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol/_Period; swing counts default 5; harmonic geometry instrument-agnostic.
why_new_for_mis: Fibonacci multi-leg swing geometry as a structured reversal-zone regime sensor with explicit anti-repaint lock—MIS can score PRZ-like windows from ratio compliance, not just named Cypher labels.

mechanism: Each new day compute midnight→6AM high/low from open/close extremes of bars in that window. Valid breakout window = post-6AM scan bar through 11AM. Require close beyond range high/low inside that window, then Break-of-Structure on timeframe_bos (default M5): swing high/low over length=4 neighbors; trade only when Ask>swing_H or Bid<swing_L AND that swing lies inside [minimum_price, maximum_price] of the midnight range.
data_needed: D1 midnight iTime; PeriodSeconds bars midnight→sixAM; max/min range prices; timeframe_bos swings; validBreakTime_start/end.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any FX _Symbol; chart TF for range; BoS TF default PERIOD_M5 (user-selectable); session clock midnight–6AM / break to 11AM.
why_new_for_mis: Overnight consolidation range plus lower-TF structure break constrained inside that range is a session-transition change sensor—cleaner than raw range breakouts without BoS or BoS without session context.
quote: Check if the Ask price breaks above the swing high within the range… swing_H <= maximum_price && swing_H >= minimum_price

mechanism: Each dashboard refresh: spread=(ask−bid)/Point. Color/state tiers: ≤2.0 points favorable (VALUE_POSITIVE), ≤5.0 medium (VALUE_ACTIVE), else costly (VALUE_NEGATIVE). Paired with daily drawdown % from HistorySelect day P&L vs starting balance that can flip tradingEnabled off.
data_needed: SYMBOL_ASK/BID; Point(); optional ENABLE_DAILY_DRAWDOWN + DRAWDOWN_LIMIT from day’s DEAL_ENTRY_OUT profit+commission+swap.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol any digits; tick/dashboard update; day boundary via TimeToString date.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit live spread-tier liquidity/cost sensor (not just a UI chrome)—MIS can gate entries when spread leaves the low/medium band as a thin-liquidity hazard.
quote: if (spread <= 2.0) { spreadColor = VALUE_POSITIVE_COLOR; } else if (spread <= 5.0) { spreadColor = VALUE_ACTIVE_COLOR; } else { spreadColor = VALUE_NEGATIVE_COLOR; }

mechanism: Two Envelopes channels on M1: upper band SMA(150)±0.1% deviation and lower band SMA(95)±1.4%; plus RSI(8), EMA(200), and M30 SMAs (periods 14/9). Sell bounce when Bid under upper Envelope, between short SMAs, RSI crosses above OpenSell threshold from below, with optional spacing from last order; buy is the mirror at lower Envelope. Part 19 wires execution/risk on the same signals.
data_needed: iEnvelopes handles (150/0.1 and 95/1.4); iRSI(8); iMA EMA200 and SMA8/SMA4; Bid/Ask circular buffers.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: M1 Envelopes/RSI/EMA200; M30 SMA trend filters; forex pip/point scaling.
why_new_for_mis: Asymmetric dual-deviation Envelopes plus RSI cross as a trend-following mean-reversion regime (bounce-at-band-in-trend)—richer than single Bollinger/Envelope touch sensors.
quote: buy signals when the price touches the lower band in an uptrend and sell signals when it hits the upper band in a downtrend, confirmed by trend filters like a 200-period Exponential Moving Average (EMA) or 8-period Relative Strength Index (RSI).

mechanism: Per symbol: CCI(per_signal) on tf_signal (M5) crosses up through cci_signal_buy_value (−90) with AO rising, or crosses down through cci_signal_sell_value (130) with AO falling. Trend TF (H1) CCI must also sit between CCI_TREND_BUY_VALUE (−114) and CCI_TREND_SELL_VALUE (134) with directional CCI slope (and optional AO trend). Only if spread < max_spread and no open magic positions. Multi-symbol loop over comma-separated list.
data_needed: iCCI signal+trend handles; iAO signal+trend; SymbolInfo spread; CountOrders by magic; candle_shift 0/1 from trade_anytime.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Default EURUSDm,GBPUSDm,AUDUSDm; tf_signal PERIOD_M5; tf_trend PERIOD_H1; max_spread 20.
why_new_for_mis: Cross-symbol dual-timeframe CCI threshold-cross with AO slope confirm is a portable multi-asset reversal-change sensor—MIS can fan the same template across a watchlist.

mechanism: Copy 10 ATR(14) bars; atrRatio = atr[0]/close. newNeurons = MinHiddenNeurons + (MaxHiddenNeurons−MinHiddenNeurons)×min(atrRatio×100, 1.0), clamped to [Min,Max]. On each new bar ResizeNetwork if count changes, then retrain/forward with MA20, MA50, RSI, ATR-normalized inputs into 10-in / 2-out sigmoid net.
data_needed: iATR(14); iClose; MinHiddenNeurons/MaxHiddenNeurons; ma20/ma50/rsi/atr feature vector for SetInput.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol PERIOD_CURRENT; ATR period 14; TrainingBarCount default 1000.
why_new_for_mis: Maps live ATR/price ratio directly into model capacity—volatility as a structural sensor that widens/narrows the net, not only as a stop distance.

mechanism: After each training epoch store trainingError in errorHistory (rolling MAX_HISTORY_SIZE). AdjustLearningRate: if lastError < prevError → LR×1.05 capped at MaxLearningRate; else if lastError > prevError×1.2 → LR×0.9 floored at MinLearningRate; else LR×0.99. Used during TrainOnHistoricalData / online updates so weight steps accelerate when loss falls and damp when loss spikes.
data_needed: errorHistory[]; historyRecordCount≥2; MinLearningRate/MaxLearningRate; epoch MSE from output vs targets.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same NN trading EA on chart symbol; training epochs up to 100; MinPredictionAccuracy 0.7 gate.
why_new_for_mis: Online LR schedule driven by consecutive training-error deltas is a neural training-state sensor—MIS can treat LR/error trajectory as a meta-signal of how stable the learned market mapping currently is.
quote: if(lastError < prevError) currentLearningRate = MathMin(currentLearningRate * 1.05, MaxLearningRate); else if(lastError > prevError * 1.2) currentLearningRate = MathMax(currentLearningRate * 0.9, MinLearningRate);

mechanism: Entry when RSI(8) transitions through oversold/overbought (30/70) while price is stretched beyond dual Envelopes (upper 150/0.1, lower 95/1.4): e.g. RSI rising from oversold with Ask above upper band → buy; RSI falling from overbought with Bid below lower band → sell. Zone recovery (zoneSizePoints/zoneTargetPoints) is loss-management around that stretch-reversal seed, refined in Part 23 with baskets/trailing.
data_needed: iRSI(8); iEnvelopes upper/lower buffers; rsiOverbought/Oversold constants; zoneSizePoints/zoneTargetPoints for recovery geometry.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: PERIOD_CURRENT chart symbol; RSI 8; Envelopes 150/0.1 and 95/1.4; zone points in price units.
why_new_for_mis: Combines oscillator extreme transition with price outside asymmetric Envelope channel as a stretch-reversal regime seed—usable even without adopting zone-recovery execution.
quote: if (m_rsiBuffer[1] < rsiOversold && m_rsiBuffer[2] > rsiOversold && m_rsiBuffer[0] < rsiOversold) { if (askPrice > m_envUpperBandBuffer[0]) { signalType = ORDER_TYPE_BUY; }

mechanism: Fixed Pre-London window 03:00→LondonStart (default 09:00). GetRange via iHighest/iLowest over that bar span → LondonRangePoints. If range < MinRangePoints or > MaxRangePoints set noTradeToday (skip pending stops); else place BuyStop above high+offset and SellStop below low−offset with RRRatio TPs. Daily drawdown from peak equity can also force noTradeToday.
data_needed: PreLondonStartHour/Minute; LondonStartHour/Minute; iHighest/iLowest highs/lows; MinRangePoints/MaxRangePoints; OrderOffsetPoints; MaxDailyDrawdownPercent.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol/_Period; London session clock (hours configurable); MinRange 100 / MaxRange 300 points default.
why_new_for_mis: Session pre-range width as a binary tradeability/regime gate (too quiet or too wild → stand aside)—MIS can treat overnight/Asian range size as a London-open volatility regime prior.
quote: if (preLondonRange < MinRangePoints || preLondonRange > MaxRangePoints) { noTradeToday = true; … return; }
